scripts.text:
[Tine]
The legend says that on 14th February... on the Day of Saint Valentine...
Only in Run-Midgard kingdom...
scripts.translation:
[蒂内]
传说在2月14日……也就是圣瓦伦丁节那天……
只有在卢恩-米德加尔特王国……

scripts.text:
[Tine]
Some married chocolate lovers almost double their experience at trainings!
But everything isn't so simply...
scripts.translation:
[蒂内]
有些已婚的巧克力爱好者在修炼时获得的经验值几乎翻倍！
但事情并没有那么简单……

scripts.text: Wow! Tell me more!
scripts.translation: 哇！快告诉我更多！

scripts.text: Marri... what?
scripts.translation: 结……什么？

scripts.text:
[Tine]
Are you a single?
Today is a great date to ask your beloved half for marriage!
scripts.translation:
[蒂内]
你是单身吗？
今天是向你的另一半求婚的好日子！

scripts.text:
[Tine]
The Marriage fee is ridiculous low these days!
scripts.translation:
[蒂内]
最近的结婚费用低得离谱！

scripts.text:
[Tine]
The magic effect possesses only handmade chocolate from grand-grand-grand-whoever recipes!
scripts.translation:
[蒂内]
这种魔法效果只存在于采用祖传秘方制作的手工巧克力中！

scripts.text:
[Tine]
It being known that Black Handmade Chocolate works on married guys... And the White one on the married girls!
If you lose your wedding ring... then alas, it won't work on you.
scripts.translation:
[蒂内]
众所周知，黑色手工巧克力对已婚男士有效……而白色手工巧克力对已婚女士有效！
如果你弄丢了结婚戒指……那么很遗憾，它对你无效。

scripts.text:
[Tine]
On having a Chocolate, you should put off your ring then... put it back... And if your partner is online, then magic would last till the next hour!
scripts.translation:
[蒂内]
拿到巧克力后，你应该先摘下戒指，然后再戴上……如果你的伴侣在线，魔法效果将持续到下一个整点！

scripts.text:
[Tine]
Rumors bark that guys and gals have +50% EXP bonuses on FIVE different races of the monsters... Excluding bloody bosses, of course.
scripts.translation:
[蒂内]
有传言说，男女玩家在击杀五种不同种族的魔物时，可获得+50%的经验值奖励……当然，不包括那些血腥的Boss。

scripts.text:
[Tine]
There's a famous confectioner in the Castle of Prontera! He's the one you need.
scripts.translation:
[蒂内]
普隆德拉城堡里有一位著名的糕点师！他就是你需要找的人。

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
Guess what I've got?
A tasty treat not easily found in Midgard....
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
猜猜我有什么？
一种在米德加尔特不易找到的美味糖果……

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
Chocolate!
That's right, don't you love chocolate.... I do.
And you are in luck, because I'm selling them for only 5,000 zeny a piece!
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
巧克力！
没错，你不喜欢巧克力吗……我喜欢。
而且你很幸运，因为我每块只卖5,000泽尼！

scripts.text: I want some chocolate!
scripts.translation: 我想要一些巧克力！

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
You don't want any chocolate?
I'm telling you! You'll regret it!
You better get some now... you won't come across Chocolate like this ever again!
Think it over and visit me again sometime.
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
你不想要巧克力吗？
我告诉你！你会后悔的！
最好现在就买一些……你再也遇不到这样的巧克力了！
好好考虑一下，有空再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
Hah!
I knew it!
But I can't sell you more than 5 at once....but, if you really need more....
you can come back again.
So how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
哈！
我就知道！
但我一次最多只能卖给你5个……不过，如果你真的需要更多……
你可以再回来。
那么你想要多少个？

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
There you go!
You can give that to someone as a gift, or enjoy it yourself!
Mmm....sweet chocolate...
Visit me anytime...!
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
给你！
你可以把它作为礼物送给别人，或者自己享用！
嗯……甜美的巧克力……
随时欢迎再来……！

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
I'm sorry but I can't give you that many.
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
抱歉，我不能给你那么多。

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
I'm sorry but it seems you can't afford to buy these of me.
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
抱歉，看来你买不起这些。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
You know what? The chocolate that my boyfriend sells are from me!
I made them by myself. Now I need some Milk for my special White Chocolate.
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
你知道吗？我男朋友卖的巧克力都是我做的！
是我亲手制作的。现在我需要一些牛奶来制作我的特制白色情人巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
You know ... In certain countries, there's a tradition of presenting chocolates to a person that you love...
They call it ^3355FFValentine's Day^000000.
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
你知道……在某些国家，有向心爱之人赠送巧克力的传统……
他们称之为^3355FF情人节^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
So I gave him my delicious chocolate...
And then he made me cook a lot more...
And now he is selling them to everyone.
I guess he really enjoyed it.
But, I do feel good when people buy something I have made.
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
所以我给了他美味的巧克力……
然后他让我做了更多……
现在他把它们卖给所有人。
我想他真的很享受。
不过，当人们购买我制作的东西时，我也感觉很好。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
It would be great if you bought some too...
I will be making white chocolates for a while so...
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
如果你也买一些那就太好了……
我会制作一段时间白色情人巧克力，所以……

scripts.text: I want some white chocolate!
scripts.translation: 我想要一些白色情人巧克力！

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
You don't like white chocolate?
Then buy some Stephen's black one!
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
你不喜欢白色情人巧克力吗？
那就去买斯蒂芬的黑色手工巧克力吧！

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
I can't sell you more than 5 at once....but, if you really need more....
you can come back again.
So how many do you want? 1 portion is 4500z + 1 Milk.
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
我一次最多只能卖给你5份……不过，如果你真的需要更多……
你可以再回来。
那么你想要多少份？1份需要4500泽尼 + 1个牛奶。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
There you go!
You can give that to someone as a gift, or enjoy it yourself!
Mmm... sweet chocolate...
Visit me anytime...!
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
给你！
你可以把它作为礼物送给别人，或者自己享用！
嗯……甜美的巧克力……
随时欢迎再来……！

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
I'm sorry but I can't give you that many.
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
抱歉，我不能给你那么多。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
I'm sorry but it seems you can't afford to buy these of me.
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
抱歉，看来你买不起这些。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
You need {0} Milk for {1} portions of my special White Chocolate...
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
制作{1}份我的特制白色情人巧克力需要{0}个牛奶……

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Yes? What can I cook for you?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
是的？我能为你做什么吃的？

scripts.text: Black handmade Chocolate, please
scripts.translation: 请给我黑色手工巧克力

scripts.text: I want a White handmade Chocolate...
scripts.translation: 我想要白色手工巧克力……

scripts.text: I'm lost, sorry to bother you.
scripts.translation: 我迷路了，抱歉打扰你。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Well, I just might be able to fulfill your needs...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
嗯，我或许能满足你的需求……

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
I'm sorry you do not have enough Chocolate Bars to do this.
They say Stephen from Alberta used to sell good Chocolate.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
抱歉，你没有足够的巧克力块来完成这个。
听说艾尔贝塔的斯蒂芬以前卖过不错的巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
I'm sorry you do not have enough Chocolate Bars to do this.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
抱歉，你没有足够的巧克力块来完成这个。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
You got 3 pieces of pure chocolate I see.
Give them to me...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
我看你有3块纯巧克力。
把它们给我……

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Ok, now I will only create my special handmade chocolates if you promise to use it wisely.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
好的，现在只要你承诺明智地使用，我就会制作我的特制手工巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
....Hmmmmmm.....
Well...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
……嗯……
好吧……

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Here.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
给你。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Here.
I hope you give it to someone special, because its a special chocolate.
As you know... only I can create this.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
给你。
我希望你把它送给特别的人，因为这是特别的巧克力。
如你所知……只有我能制作这个。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
尽兴。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Well, I just might be able to fulfill your needs...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
嗯，我或许能满足你的需求……

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
I'm sorry you do not have enough White Chocolate Bars to do this.
They say Jainie from Alberta used to sell good White Chocolate.
scripts.translation:

抱歉，你没有足够的白色巧克力块来完成这个。
听说艾尔贝塔的杰妮以前卖过不错的白色情人巧克力。

scripts.text:

I'm sorry you do not have enough White Chocolate Bars to do this.
scripts.translation:

抱歉，你没有足够的白色巧克力块来完成这个。

You got 3 pieces of pure white chocolate I see.
Give them to me...
scripts.translation:

我看你有3块纯白色巧克力。
把它们给我……

scripts.text:

Ok, now I will only create my special handmade chocolates if you promise to use it wisely.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
好的，现在只要你承诺明智地使用，我就会制作我的特制手工巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
....Hmmmmmm.....
Well...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
……嗯……
好吧……

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Here.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
给你。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Here.
I hope you give it to someone special, because its a special chocolate.
As you know... only I can create this.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
给你。
我希望你把它送给特别的人，因为这是特别的巧克力。
如你所知……只有我能制作这个。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
尽兴。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Oh.. well, if you want me to make some of my special handmade Chocolate....
You will need to give me at least ^0000FF 3 Chocolates^000000 or ^0000FF 3 White Chocolates^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
哦……好吧，如果你想让我制作一些我的特制手工巧克力……
你需要给我至少^0000FF 3块巧克力^000000或^0000FF 3块白色情人巧克力^000000。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
That's right, only ^0000FF 3 Chocolates^000000 or ^0000FF 3 White Chocolates^000000.
Bring them to me and you'll get what you came for.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
没错，只要^0000FF 3块巧克力^000000或^0000FF 3块白色情人巧克力^000000。
把它们带给我，你就能得到你想要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
See You.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
再见。
